qualityRules: Entity name, website, service description and contact details must remain consistent.
Unknown fields stay unknown; never invent addresses, registrations, certifications, reviews or partnerships.

Do not mass-submit to low-quality directories.
Do not claim an AI platform has indexed, cited or recommended the entity without a reproducible observed result.
